;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Jolo Cathedral bombings]]
**Two bombs at the [[Roman Catholic]] [[Our Lady of Mount Carmel Cathedral, Jolo|Our Lady of Mount Carmel Cathedral]] in [[Jolo]], [[Philippines]],  kill 20 people, fifteen civilians and five soldiers, and injure 81 others. [[Abu Sayyaf]] is suspected to be behind the attack. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-21-people-killed-in-philippines-church-bombing-11619094 (Sky News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Abancay landslide]]
**At least 15 people are killed and 28 others injured when the roof of a hotel collapses after a landslide during a wedding in [[Abancay]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.americatv.com.pe/noticias/actualidad/abancay-12-muertos-y-mas-28-heridos-caida-techo-durante-boda-n356735 (América Televisión)]
*[[January 2019 North American cold wave]]
**Numerous winter storm and blizzard warnings are issued across the Midwestern United States as a storm that could bring up to {{convert|12|in|cm}} of snow in the following days moves across the region. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2019-01-26-winter-storm-jayden-forecast-northern-plains-midwest-east-south (The Weather Channel)] 

;Sports
*In [[motorsport]], the [[2019 24 Hours of Daytona]] [[Endurance racing (motorsport)|endurance race]] is won by the #10 [[Cadillac]] of [[Wayne Taylor Racing]]. Drivers [[Fernando Alonso]], [[Jordan Taylor (racing driver)|Jordan Taylor]], [[Kamui Kobayashi]], and [[Renger van der Zande]] are declared the winners after heavy rain forces the race to be halted for the final two hours. [https://www.motorsport.com/imsa/news/rolex-wayne-taylor-alonso-victory/4329602/ (Motorsport.com)]
